decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.7299. Series context: trend strength 0.9721 and seasonal strength 0.061; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.049); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 10.075.
